combo_label: The Village Fete × Puppets & Punch and Judy × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: How heavy a thing is, in pounds and ounces, kept secret in a sealed envelope
Steel spikes hammered into the field so guy ropes can hold the canvas taut
Bell-shaped pot naming the incomers of the later third millennium BC
Rough estimate written on a numbered sheet, a coin in the tin, and nearest one wins
Threads running from the control bar down to a marionette's head, arms and knees
Body part a cloth puppet is pulled onto like a mitten, its operator out of sight below
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Hot brown brew poured from a big metal urn in the refreshment tent, milk already in it
Red deer digging tool, left in the earthwork, that levered out the chalk
Stiff shaft worked from beneath to move a puppet's arm or turn its head
Row of little triangular flags on a string, left out in the rain and gone limp
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
